title: A Reflective LLM-based Agent to Guide Zero-shot Cryptocurrency Trading

extraction.methodology_summary: CryptoTrade uses a multi-agent Large Language Model framework combining on-chain data (such as transaction counts, active wallets, and gas prices) and off-chain data (financial news summaries) to make daily trading decisions. Specialized analytical agents evaluate market trends, news impact, and trading actions, while a reflection agent reviews past performance to iteratively refine the strategy. The framework operates in a zero-shot manner across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana under different market conditions.
extraction.data_period: Dataset covering several months in 2023 across bull, sideways, and bear conditions, daily

key_findings: CryptoTrade successfully integrates on-chain and off-chain data to guide zero-shot cryptocurrency trading decisions using LLMs.

CryptoTrade consistently outperforms Transformer-based time-series baselines and performs competitively compared to traditional strategies like Buy and Hold and MACD across various market conditions without fine-tuning.
Ablation studies reveal that incorporating on-chain transaction statistics, news, technical indicators, and self-reflection significantly improves overall strategy performance.
The framework effectively captures market trends and exploits pricing dynamics such as the 'buy the rumor, sell the news' phenomenon around major events like Bitcoin ETF approvals.
limitations: Reliance on a relatively limited dataset.
Trading actions are restricted to day-to-day frequency rather than higher-frequency intervals.
Lack of fine-tuning for the LLMs using the validation set may lead to underperformance compared to some traditional signals.
